verdict.rationale: Edge0 ships its own Python library API with transformers-style `AutoModel`/`AutoConfig`/`AutoEngine` classes and `AutoEngine.from_pretrained(...)`, so developers can build against a first-party programmatic interface. Its OpenAI-compatible `/v1/chat/completions` server is a protocol endpoint, not an official SDK. The iOS, Android, Windows and macOS entries are apps and native engines, not documented SDKs. missing for 10: official SDKs in multiple languages (e.g. JS/TS, Swift, Kotlin), a published SDK reference and packaging, an SDK for the HTTP server, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
